title: Treasure on Pirate Island
description: Three friends follow a map to find treasure on an island.
instructions: Read the adventure story. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🏝️ Sam, Lucy and Linh were on holiday at the seaside. One rainy day, they found an old map in a box in the hotel. It showed a place called Pirate Island, and a big red X.
'It's a treasure map!' said Sam. 'We must find the treasure.' The next morning, the sun was shining. They asked a fisherman to take them to the island in his small boat.
On the island, they followed the map. First, they walked past a tall palm tree. Then they climbed over some big rocks, which were hot and difficult to climb.
Suddenly, Lucy shouted, 'Look! There's a cave!' It was dark and cold inside. Linh had a torch in her bag. 'If we stay together, we won't be afraid,' she said.
At the end of the cave, they saw a wooden box under a pile of stones. They moved the stones one by one. It took them nearly an hour because the stones were so heavy.
Sam opened the box slowly. Inside, there were no gold coins. There was only a small book and a note. The note said, 'The best treasure is a good story. Write yours here.'
The children laughed. 'It isn't money, but it's special,' said Linh. They sat on the beach and wrote their names and their adventure in the book. Then Lucy drew the cave.
Before they left, they put the box back in the cave. 'Other children will find it one day,' said Sam. The fisherman was waiting for them, and he was smiling.
